title: Creative Quarterly (CQ) 85th International Juried Competition
description: Enter art, advertising, design, illustration, or photography for CQ's 85th juried competition. Winners feature in the annual.
descriptionDetailed: Creative Quarterly's 85th international juried competition accepts commissioned and personal work in advertising, graphic design, illustration, photography, and fine art, judged separately for professionals and students. Winning work features in the online gallery and the 2026 Annual, with winners receiving certificates and a complimentary eBook.

entry.feeNote: Professional $35 single, $70 series; students $20 single, $35 series; theme and portfolio $35 for up to 5 images

prize.prizeSummary: Publication in the 2026 Annual, online gallery feature, and certificates
prize.description: Winning work is featured in the online gallery and in the 2026 Creative Quarterly Annual, a softbound book that also lists all runners-up. Winners receive a complimentary eBook version and may purchase the printed Annual at a discount. Winners and runners-up receive a complimentary award certificate PDF.

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to designers, artists, and photographers worldwide
audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to art directors, designers, illustrators, photographers, and fine artists in all countries, at professional, student, or amateur level. Professional and student entries are judged separately. AI-generated images are not accepted.
